notes: About 12:30 a.m. Eastern, security guard Frank Wills finds masking tape holding a latch open between the garage and a stairwell at the Watergate office complex. He peels it off and keeps walking.
About half an hour later the tape is back on the same door. Wills phones the Second Precinct from the lobby.

description: Five men in the Democratic offices
notes: Police arrest Bernard Barker, Virgilio Gonzalez, Eugenio Martinez, Frank Sturgis, and James McCord inside the Democratic National Committee headquarters. Later accounts place the arrests around 2:30 a.m. They are carrying bugging gear and about $2,300 in hundred-dollar bills.

location: During the arrest, police notice a man watching from the hotel across the street. Howard Hunt tells Alfred Baldwin to get rid of the burglars' van and anything else that ties them to the room.

description: The Washington Post is called in
notes: Around 9:00 a.m., Bob Woodward is called to the newsroom for an odd burglary. Carl Bernstein and Alfred Lewis are already on it.
At 3:30 p.m. the five appear in court. Assistant U.S. Attorney Earl Silbert asks that they be held. Asked about his government service, James McCord whispers "CIA."

description: A burglar is tied to the campaign
notes: The next day, James McCord is connected to the Committee for the Re-Election of the President. The break-in is no longer a strange local crime.
